findings.message: The `git diff` failure fix still has one variant row, a root commit with no parent. The stub only fails `git show`, so a `git diff` that fails for another reason (unreachable HEAD^1 in a shallow clone, repo error) is never exercised. Extend the git stub to fail `diff` under an env var and add a row. The current row would catch removal of the `|| exit 1`, so this is a coverage gap, not a wrong-behaviour finding.
findings.scenario: n/a (coverage gap; the code treats every `git diff` failure the same way)

findings.message: `scenario` sets `got=error` whenever rc != 0, even if a dispatch was also recorded in $CALLS. Rows expecting `error` therefore never assert that nothing was dispatched. For the unreadable-status rows, also assert $CALLS is empty (for example, report `error+dispatch` as a distinct outcome).
findings.scenario: n/a (a step that dispatches and then exits non-zero for an unreadable file would still pass the error rows)
